title: Odometry message frames
keywords: odometry odom twist pose child_frame_id frame_id velocity wheel publish_tf jump
text: nav_msgs/Odometry gives the pose in header.frame_id (usually odom) and the twist in child_frame_id (usually base_link), so forward speed is twist.linear.x in the robot's own frame. The same odom -> base_link transform is normally also published on /tf, by exactly one node. If both a wheel odometry node and a filter such as robot_localization publish it, the robot jumps between two poses: let only one of them publish the transform.
